lines.en: Two wingbeats carry me a stretch.

lines.zh: 草尖一颤，我就换个地方。
lines.en: One shiver of grass and I move on.

lines.zh: 我的翅很薄，风一吹就偏。
lines.en: My wings are thin. Wind shifts me.

lines.zh: 我绕着一朵花飞了两圈。
lines.en: I circle a flower twice.
I rise and dip in the air.
I fly over, then back.

lines.zh: 我穿过叶子和叶子之间。
lines.en: I slip between leaf and leaf.
The wind here is soft. Easy flying.
I fly and look for flowers.
A block off the ground. High enough.
Not fast. But steady.
The blade of grass bends a little.
I cross the stream and circle back.
My shadow on the grass is tiny.

lines.zh: 我顺着阳光的方向飞，花瓣在下面。
lines.en: I fly toward the sunlight, petals below.

lines.zh: 我飞得很轻，不惊动什么。
lines.en: I fly lightly. Nothing's disturbed.
I rest on a petal, wings folded.
I drink nectar. Slowly.
My wings open and close. Lightly.
On the leaf's underside, my wings folded.
A gust. I grip the petal.
I'm looking at the flowers further off.
Quiet here. Good.
I open my wings slowly to sun them.
Fine dust on my wings.

lines.zh: 我转了个方向，对着太阳。
lines.en: I turn toward the sun.
The wind scatters the powder from my wings.

lines.zh: 这一朵花，够我待一会儿。
lines.en: This flower will hold me a while.

lines.zh: 我落在花瓣上，翅慢慢合。
lines.en: On a petal, my wings fold slowly.
Startled, I fly higher.
You're big. One flap and I'm gone.
I settle on the wildflower beside you.
Catching me? These wings tear.
I raise my wings to show the colour.
I circle you and find no flower.
I hover at your eye level.

lines.zh: 我往前飞了一点，又退回来。
lines.en: I fly forward a little, then back.

lines.zh: 你不动，我就落在你肩上。
lines.en: Hold still and I'll land on your shoulder.
A nick in my wing.
Wing dust trails behind me.

lines.zh: 六点血的我，捏一下就散。
lines.en: Six points of health. One pinch and I scatter.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的粉掉了，我飞不稳。
lines.en: The dust is off my wings. I fly unsteadily.
I spin once before steadying.

lines.zh: 才六点血，翅粉撒了一地
lines.en: Only six health, and my dust scatters.
A split on the wing edge. I can still fly.
Skimming the grass tips, I can't rise.
My antenna broke; I can't fly steady.
A little sun on my wings and I'll fly again.
The scent of nectar drifts over.
I land on the petal's edge for a first taste.

lines.zh: 这味道，我从两格外就闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled that two blocks away.
My proboscis reaches into the flower's heart.
This one's drained; on to the next.
Raise the flower and I circle twice.
Pollen on my legs now.
Don't pick it; let it bloom one more day.
I've rested long enough on this flower.
One more and I'll go.
I rest on the tip of a grass blade.
A wing was knocked. I fly crooked.

lines.zh: 落到地上，又扑扇着飞起。
lines.en: Down to the ground, then flutter up again.
One loop around you, back to the flower.
I land back on the flower, my wing still crooked.
Your hand swings, and the flower sways.
I hover in the wind and steady myself.
My wing edge curled; I smooth it and fly.
So light, one bump tilts me.
I rest a moment on your sleeve.
I circle above the flowers.
Another joins the circle.
Wing to wing, we traced the same circle.
This is brief. Over in a moment.
The eggs stick to the leaf's underside, tiny.
The leaf will hold them.
One after the other, into the flowers.
The stem still sways; we're gone.
Only sun and wind in this part.

lines.zh: 我记住了它翅上的颜色。
lines.en: I remember the colour on its wings.
The petal is so soft I sink a little.
Not a flower. I lift off at once.
Pollen dusts my legs all over.
The petal is slick; I slip a step.
Six legs hold the stamen.
I shake the pollen onto the next flower.
That smells wrong — don't give it to me.
A moment's rest, then up again.
The flower's still open. Tomorrow.
Carried it two blocks.
That flower. I see it.
I'm as small as a fallen leaf.
Something's moving. I keep away.
I climb half a block.
One wingbeat and I'm before you.
Someone's by the flower. Go around.
Both antennae probe the flower's heart.
I'll taste this flower first.
The wind at my back pushes me on.
I circle to find a landing spot.

lines.zh: 我停在叶边，先看一会儿。
lines.en: I settle at the leaf's edge and watch.
So many flowers. I'll pick one.
I fly straight at that flower.
Excuse me; I need to land.
Hovering over the flower, wings still beating.
Lower and lower, wings never stopping.
Nectar in this one. I smell it.
Circling it, hunting the right angle.
Half a block closer and I take off.
I land on the edge. Lightly.
Just close enough to reach the flower's heart.
The sun's turning. I won't wait.
I ride the wind. Less effort.
A little closer and I land.

lines.zh: 我落在一片叶子上喘气。
lines.en: I land on a leaf to catch my breath.
My wing sweeps past, stirring air.
Scale dust scatters across your face.
My mouth is a coil; it can't bite.

lines.zh: 六点血的小翅，飞得很轻。
lines.en: Six health of wing, flying very light.
I hit and leave.
I land on your hand, nearly weightless.
I miss and my wing tips askew.
Around you, back to the petal.
I only dodge. I don't fight.
My wings unfold, still damp.
Day's breaking. I bask my wings.

lines.zh: 我扇两下翅，就飘了一段。
lines.en: Two beats of my wings carry me a little way.
These flowers are at their best.
Two turns to find the flower.
One beat and the grass stirs.
Good wind. I can go far.

lines.zh: 我这么小，不容易被看见。
lines.en: I'm small. Easy to miss.
I circle once above the flowers.
Enough flowers here for a day's work.
The heat comes, and my wing tips curl.
I land in the grass with dirt on my wings.

lines.zh: 我的翅太薄，一沾水就沉。
lines.en: My wings are too thin; water sinks them.

lines.zh: 炸响把我吹出好远，翅膀还在抖。
lines.en: The blast blew me far; my wings still tremble.

lines.zh: 翅上开了洞，我还是能飞。
lines.en: A hole in the wing, and I still fly.
The magic light burns along my wing edges.

lines.zh: 没有花蜜，我撑不了多久。
lines.en: No nectar, and I won't last.
Rain has soaked my wings.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，翅膀扇不起来。
lines.en: Nothing below, my wings cannot beat.
